description: Linux kernel driver for the Ubiquiti RGB LED controller (LEDBAR) connected via I2C, managing LED brightness and GPIO controls.

methods.name: ubnt_ledbar_perform_transaction
methods.description: Performs an I2C transaction by writing bytes and reading response.

methods.name: ubnt_ledbar_apply_state
methods.description: Applies the current LED brightness state to the hardware.

methods.name: ubnt_ledbar_reset
methods.description: Resets and initializes the LED controller MCU.

methods.name: ubnt_ledbar_set_red_brightness
methods.description: Sets brightness for the red LED.

methods.name: ubnt_ledbar_set_green_brightness
methods.description: Sets brightness for the green LED.

methods.name: ubnt_ledbar_set_blue_brightness
methods.description: Sets brightness for the blue LED.

methods.name: ubnt_ledbar_init_led
methods.description: Initializes an individual LED class device.

methods.name: ubnt_ledbar_probe
methods.description: Probe function called during device initialization.
